decision: Measure one stock/candidate pair; retain any valid positive result and close this intervention on a valid non-positive result.

measured_discovery_gap.name: gpu_idle_or_host_gap
measured_discovery_gap.evidence: measured discovery proxy; asynchronous and not additive

hypothesis.causal_limiter: After verify() has copied num_correct_drafts to CPU and advanced batch.seq_lens_cpu, the consumer redundantly executes verify_input.num_correct_drafts.cpu().tolist(), introducing a second dependent D2H synchronization.
hypothesis.intervention: Snapshot the CPU seq_lens mirror immediately before verify(), then derive drafts-only accepted counts as updated_seq_lens_cpu - prior_seq_lens_cpu - 1.
hypothesis.predicted_physical_change: Remove one [batch] int32 CUDA-to-CPU accepted-count transfer and its dependent host synchronization per target-verify step; the discovery window contains 15 target-verify calls, so the predicted named movement is up to 15 fewer redundant D2H/sync boundaries.
hypothesis.falsifier: Any request, target/emitted token, finish reason, prompt/completion/cache accounting, or 32/32 completion mismatch forbids a performance claim.

exact_contract.phase: mixed prefill/decode endpoint; candidate change executes only after TARGET_VERIFY in acceptance bookkeeping
exact_contract.cuda_graph_mode: TARGET_VERIFY may use padded CUDA-graph replay up to batch 32; the intervention is after replay and preserves graph inputs, capture, dynamic/padded batch choice, and fallback paths.

boundary.gpu_tensor: NgramVerifyInput.num_correct_drafts: contiguous [batch], torch.int32, CUDA, no scale
boundary.cpu_mirror: ScheduleBatch.seq_lens_cpu: contiguous [batch], torch integer CPU tensor, no scale
boundary.ownership: row i remains request i; delta subtracts the one bonus token exactly as the stock drafts-only count

invariants: same model revision, checkpoint values, image digest and runtime flags
same endpoint_pair.py:arm -> run_c32 -> exact_runner.py:main call chain
stock arm first and candidate arm second, exactly once
identical request hashes, target/emitted token IDs, finish reasons, prompt/completion/cache accounting
same NGRAM and decode-equivalent LM-head features
no change to CUDA graph capture/replay, attention, logits, cache allocation, sampling, or corpus update

source.unchanged_fallback: The stock image source remains active for the stock arm; candidate mounts only ngram_worker.py and preserves all non-TARGET_VERIFY and unsupported paths.

quality_gate: One profiler-off stock/candidate exact-c32 pair with raw timing and token identities; valid only on all invariants.
